create_adam_optimizer: create an Adam optimizer with configurable learning rate, betas, epsilon, and weight decay for model training
build_fairseq_adam: build a FairseqAdam optimizer that auto-selects between FusedAdam, standard Adam, or TPU Adam based on hardware
run_adam_step: run a single Adam optimization step with FP16/BF16 gradient casting and bias-corrected moment estimates
review_fairseqadamconfig: review the FairseqAdamConfig dataclass to customize adam_betas, adam_eps, weight_decay, and learning rate settings
test_average_params: test the average_params method to reduce and synchronize optimizer state across GPUs during BMUF distributed training
